evals.name: purposeful-dashboard-motion
evals.prompt: Add motion to the dashboard and signup flow so it feels alive, without making it slow or distracting.
evals.expected_output: Purpose gate, small token set of durations/easings, transform/opacity only, reduced-motion support, and removal of gratuitous pulse/hover-scale effects.
assertions: Questions whether each animation has a purpose before adding it
Removes or replaces gratuitous animate-pulse and hover-scale effects
Specifies durations, easings, and compositor-friendly properties
Avoids animating layout properties or blocking input
Keeps motion consistent with a small token set
